places.name: Barsana Monastery
places.ai_summary: Barsana Monastery is a stunning wooden church complex, showcasing traditional Maramureș architecture and serene surroundings.
places.place_tip: Visit during sunrise for a peaceful experience.

places.name: Sapanta Merry Cemetery
places.ai_summary: Sapanta Merry Cemetery is a unique burial site with colorful tombstones and humorous epitaphs, reflecting local traditions.
places.place_tip: Hire a guide to understand the epitaphs’ meanings.

places.name: Ieud Wooden Church (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: Ieud Wooden Church is a historic church made entirely of wood, known for its impressive bell tower and beautiful frescoes.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the intricate wood carvings.

places.name: Bogdan Voda Church
places.ai_summary: Bogdan Voda Church is a historic wooden church, famous for its impressive architecture and beautiful mountain setting.
places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding area for stunning views.

places.name: Maramures Village Museum (Sighetu Marmatiei)
places.ai_summary: An open-air museum showcasing traditional Maramureș village life, with authentic wooden houses and farmsteads.

opening_hours.notes: Closed in winter, from December to March.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking.

places.name: Mocănița Steam Train (Vaser Valley)
places.ai_summary: A historic steam train ride through the picturesque Vaser Valley, offering stunning views of the Maramureș Mountains.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera for breathtaking photos.

places.name: Rozavlea Wooden Church
places.ai_summary: Rozavlea Wooden Church is a beautiful example of Maramureș wooden architecture, set in a tranquil village.
places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding village for local crafts.

places.name: Breb Traditional Village
places.ai_summary: Breb is a picturesque village known for its traditional wooden houses and beautiful natural surroundings.
places.place_tip: Try the local cheese and honey.

places.name: Sighet Memorial Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the victims of communism, located in the former Sighet Prison.
places.place_tip: Take the guided tour for detailed insights.

places.name: Botiza Carpets Workshop
places.ai_summary: A traditional workshop where you can see how the famous Botiza carpets are made.
places.place_tip: Purchase a carpet as a unique souvenir.

places.name: Valea Izei Scenic Drive
places.ai_summary: A picturesque drive through the Iza Valley, known for its stunning landscapes and traditional villages.
places.place_tip: Stop at local villages for authentic experiences.

places.name: Bârsana Wooden Bridge
places.ai_summary: A beautiful wooden bridge in Bârsana, offering picturesque views of the surrounding area.
places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds.

places.name: Poienile Izei Church (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO-listed wooden church in Poienile Izei, known for its stunning exterior and interior paintings.
places.place_tip: Admire the detailed frescoes inside.

places.name: Săpânța-Peri Monastery
places.ai_summary: Săpânța-Peri Monastery is a beautiful monastery complex, known for its impressive wooden church and peaceful gardens.
places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and enjoy the tranquility.

places.name: Maramureș Folk Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the traditional folk art and culture of the Maramureș region.
places.place_tip: Check for traditional craft demonstrations.

places.name: Sighet Market Square
places.ai_summary: The main market square in Sighetu Marmatiei, bustling with local life and commerce.
places.place_tip: Visit the local shops and try street food.

places.name: Traditional Gates Route
places.ai_summary: A scenic route featuring traditional Maramureș wooden gates, each with unique carvings and designs.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored by car or bike.

places.place_tip: Take a camera to capture the intricate gate designs.

places.ai_summary: Studios where you can see local artisans at work, creating intricate wood carvings and sculptures.
places.place_tip: Purchase a small carving as a souvenir.

places.name: Local Shepherd Villages (Breb, Ieud)
places.ai_summary: Traditional villages where you can experience the local shepherd culture and buy handmade dairy products.
places.place_tip: Try the local sheep cheese and sour cream.

places.name: Maramureș Mountains Natural Park
places.ai_summary: A stunning natural park offering hiking, wildlife watching, and breathtaking mountain scenery.
places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks for the hike.
